WITH f AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN net_amount END) st_net, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN net_amount END) web_net, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN net_amount END) tr_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 AND NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) st_nostaff,
  count(*) n, count(distinct receipt_id||'-'||line_no) dn
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(net_sales_before_returns) b, sum(returns_net) rt, sum(net_sales) ns
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT * FROM f JOIN r USING(fiscal_year,fiscal_week) ORDER BY 1,2

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND s.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY 1, 2),
returns AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(r.refund_net) AS returns_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND s.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY 1, 2),
weekly AS (
  SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_week, s.sales_net - coalesce(r.returns_net, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM sales s LEFT JOIN returns r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week))
SELECT t.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, t.fiscal_week,
       t.net_sales AS net_sales, l.net_sales AS net_sales_last_year,
       round(100.0 * (t.net_sales / l.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly t JOIN weekly l ON l.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND l.fiscal_week = t.fiscal_week
WHERE t.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY t.fiscal_week
